title: Multi-Agent Debate: Boosting the Performance of LLMs via Debating

defines.name: MAD
defines.definition: A multi-agent debate framework that has multiple LLM agents exchange arguments in a tit-for-tat manner under the supervision of a judge to reach a final answer.

defines.name: Degeneration-of-Thought
defines.definition: A failure mode in self-reflection where an LLM becomes stuck on its initial stance and cannot generate new thoughts even when the stance is incorrect.

problem: Self-reflection can suffer from degeneration of thought, causing LLMs to stick to incorrect answers instead of exploring alternative reasoning paths.
